skills.skill_desc: Every 5s to 8s (scales with <font color="a6aafb">Feathered Air Strike</font> level), Verri enters the <font color="a6aafb">Hunting</font> state. On Pharsa's next attack against an enemy hero, Verri deals extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 8% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> (+ 1% per 200 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font>) and slows them by 60% for 1s.

Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and marking them for 4s.

When Pharsa hits a marked enemy with a Basic Attack or active skill, the mark is consumed, stunning them for 1s.

Marked enemies will have their positions revealed.
Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing 475<font color="62f8fe"> (+145% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Each level-up reduces <font color="a6aafb">Spiritual Unity</font>'s interval by 1s.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Pharsa takes flight for 8s and bombards the target area, dealing 530<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within. This skill can be cast up to 4 times during the flight.

Pharsa turns into mist and wraps around Verri, gaining 150% extra Movement Speed (decays over time) and the ability to fly over terrain for 5s.

This state ends immediately when she is controlled or uses a Basic Attack or skill.
